title: Housing questions that require state or local law
facts: Security-deposit limits and return deadlines, ordinary eviction notice periods, rent-control rules, landlord entry requirements, lease termination and many habitability remedies are primarily governed by state or local law.
Federal housing law can overlay those rules through fair-housing, subsidized-housing, mortgage, foreclosure and other protections.
Hanka should identify the user's state and often city or county before giving a specific landlord-tenant deadline or deposit rule.
